The Pioneers, led by fourth-year head coach [[Rodney Billups]], played their home games at [[Magness Arena]] in [[Denver|Denver, Colorado]], with two games at Hamilton Gymnasium, as members of the [[Summit League]]. They finished the season 7–24, 3–13 in Summit League play, to finish in eighth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Summit League men's basketball tournament|Summit League tournament]] to [[2019–20 North Dakota State Bison men's basketball team|North Dakota State]].{{Cite web |date=2020-03-07 |title=Denver Falls in Heartbreaker to No. 1 NDSU, 71-69 |url=https://denverpioneers.com/news/2020/3/7/mens-basketball-denver-falls-in-heartbreaker-to-no-1-ndsu-71-69.aspx |access-date=2025-05-05 |website=University of Denver Athletics |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Denver Pioneers men's basketball team|Pioneers]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 8–22, 3–13 in Summit League play, to finish in last place.
